sfre_subtitle: Analytical measurements under stated uncertainty. Not investment advice and not an allegation about any person or company. Models are UNCALIBRATED unless governance says otherwise; unobserved data is never treated as zero.
sfre_no_datasets: none: no observations ingested yet (golden-case replay stays BLOCKED_NO_DATA)
sfre_as_of_hint: Only data that was available by the end of this day is used.
sfre_no_universe: No fund data as of this date. Upload TEFAS, holdings and BIST files in the Data tab.
sfre_seed_hint: Same data + same seed = same result hash.
sfre_run_note: The run uses ingested point-in-time data. Leverage, margin and counterparty exposure are usually unobserved and are listed, never assumed zero.
sfre_kind_tefas_hint: Workbook with “Genel Bilgiler” (price, units, investors, AUM) and “Portföy Dağılımı” (allocation) sheets.
sfre_kind_bist_eod_hint: Columns: symbol, date, close, volume (shares). Optional: open, high, low, turnover.
sfre_kind_free_float_hint: Columns: symbol, date, free-float ratio or shares (and paid-in capital if shares are absent).
sfre_kind_holdings_hint: Columns: fund code, date, stock code, weight %. Set the real publication lag below.
sfre_lag_hint: Data counts as known only after report date + lag. Wrong lag = look-ahead leakage.
sfre_reconciled: both views reconcile to the total
sfre_lower_bound: Lower bound: some channels are unobserved and excluded.
sfre_json_hint: Raw request body for /api/sfre/runs (manual fund system).
sfre_sys_intro: Every engine below is an UNCALIBRATED scenario or pattern model. Results describe what happens under the stated assumptions; they are not forecasts, and synthetic test success is not predictive validity.
sfre_sys_run_twin: Run the Financial System Digital Twin on the sample system
sfre_sys_flow: SHOCK → BALANCE-SHEET → FUNDING/LIQUIDITY → MARGIN/COLLATERAL → FORCED ACTION → MARKET IMPACT → NETWORK CONTAGION → SECOND ROUND → STATE(t+n)
sfre_sys_reconciled: ledger reconciles to the clearing engine
sfre_cap_crossSector_summary: Banks, funds, insurers, corporates, sovereign, households, foreign investors on one exposure network; shocks propagate in default waves (Rogers-Veraart clearing).
sfre_cap_fxContagion_summary: Capital flow -> FX liquidity -> exchange-rate shock -> FX debt/balance-sheet effect -> credit/liquidity losses -> contagion.
sfre_cap_sovNexus_summary: Spread shock -> bond MTM -> bank capital -> funding & credit conditions -> corporate PD/loss -> sovereign backstop -> spread (fixed point).
sfre_cap_collateral_summary: Initial/variation margin, repo haircuts, eligibility & substitution, margin-call spiral with collateral fire sales, counterparty exposure and wrong-way risk.
sfre_cap_ccp_summary: Defaulter IM -> defaulter DF -> skin-in-the-game -> survivor DF -> assessments, survivor-default propagation, cover-2 test.
sfre_cap_privateCredit_summary: Sponsor-clustered default model, leverage covenants, liquidity mismatch and gating, bank/insurer transmission.
sfre_cap_aiCrowding_summary: Shared signals/models/data -> correlated positioning -> simultaneous orders -> liquidity consumption -> impact -> stop-loss cascade.
sfre_cap_opContagion_summary: Dependency graph outage -> payment/settlement disruption -> liquidity & margin shortfall. Consequences of a GIVEN scenario only.
sfre_cap_climate_summary: Transition, physical and nature-dependency shocks into valuation, PD, insurer losses and systemic risk.
sfre_cap_digitalAssets_summary: Stablecoin run (sequential service), DeFi liquidation cascades on constant-product AMMs, oracle/bridge dependency, liquidity fragmentation.
sfre_cap_surveillance_summary: Seven point-in-time pattern detectors over message streams; Poisson/hypergeometric/permutation tests with Bonferroni control against a strictly earlier reference window.
sfre_cap_systemTwin_summary: All engines on one state: SHOCK -> BALANCE-SHEET -> FUNDING/LIQUIDITY -> MARGIN/COLLATERAL -> FORCED ACTION -> MARKET IMPACT -> NETWORK CONTAGION -> SECOND ROUND -> STATE(t+n). One aggregate market impact per asset per round; exact value-conservation ledger.
sfre_purge_warn: All ingested TEFAS/BIST observations are deleted irreversibly. Users, logins, runs, the evidence ledger and models are not deleted. The action is recorded.
sfre_fed_hint: Heavy data and compute stay on the local machine; only signed results reach the cloud.
sfre_fed_empty: No results received from a local node yet.
sfre_rep_hint: Open the current situation report, archive it, or browse past reports. Reports are also archived automatically when the level changes and once a day.
sfre_rep_note: A deleted report disappears from the list; because the record store does not allow rewriting, deletion is kept as a hiding record.
